names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9244, «Сергий (Гальковский), иеромонах, сщмч.», with the grade and rank words left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. No other folder in this corpus holds this surname.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 декабря ст. ст. — «Прмч. Сергия (1917).»

attestations.note: His line is «Прмч. Сергия (1917).», and his place in it is the whole of its own line, and the earliest death the day carries, under the rank «прмч.», a venerable-martyr — a monastic put to death. His name page gives him «сщмч.», a hieromartyr, where the day line gives «прмч.»: two readings of one death, a monk in orders put to death, and this folder follows the day line and records the other here rather than choosing between them.

death.note: The year his line closes with, and the only year this calendar gives him. Neither the line nor the name page gives a day or a month of death.
